required_limits: Source-defined activity units must be associated with the actual endpoint before conversion.
The H2 endpoint and NADH endpoint are different measurements and conditions.
A missing quantitative addback stays unknown; the reference is not a new restoration measurement.
Partial conditions or unknown physical measurement identity can leave derived controlled contrasts unavailable while preserving native rates.
Ferredoxin, hydrogenase and the coupled endpoint retain their actual assay roles; reporter dependence is not automatically physiological necessity.
HTML and its text projection must not become independent confirmations.
The anonymous target is the real E. coli AtpG sequence, not the studied Bcd/Etf complex. Source results cannot be transferred by shared functional language.
Useful saved partner components must reach and be interpreted by the actual annotation parent.
